title: Special Topics in Genres/Auteurs/Cinema Movements; The Movie Musical
description: Studies the movie musical in all its forms: from The Jazz Singer and the apotheosis of MGM musicals in the 1930s, through contemporary international musicals (Emilia Perez, The End, La La Land) and various forms, incarnations, and musical experiments in-between (West Side Story, The Umbrellas of Cherbourg, and Ingmar Bergman's opera-film: The Magic Flute).
